question: What does the face key look like?
source: claude.ai design project b5ef80fc — Face Key - Session 9.html
chosen: A — unframed reserve, three primitives, mark-samples in the gutter (also the session's own recommendation)
amendment: three implementation amendments (2026-07-12): (1) the session's premise was open water and its A-lock unframed — the map face is land and water, so the reserve takes the cartouche's hairline border (0.45) so its edge holds over terrain, matching the cartouche's own same-day landing; (2) the reserve grows 214×96 → 248×112 with the entries re-inset — the plate renders the glosses in the fallback serif (Georgia, wider than the artifact's webfont) and the longest line ran against the edge; (3) ROAD joins as a fourth line (swatch and gloss verbatim from the variant-B vocabulary, box one leading taller → 248×137) — the face draws two line vocabularies and the key should explain both; the beacon alone stays versoward
